description_en: Queries the associations of a prefix list
description_zh: 调用GetVpcPrefixListAssociations接口查询前缀列表的关联关系
kebab_example: aliyun vpc get-vpc-prefix-list-associations --prefix-list-id pl-0b7hwu670000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetVpcPrefixListAssociations

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the prefix list to query
parameters.help_zh: 要查询的前缀列表的实例ID
parameters.name: prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
Leave this parameter empty for the first query or if no next query exists.
If a next query exists, set this parameter to the NextToken value returned in the previous API call
parameters.help_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page in a paged query. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh: 分批次查询时每次显示的条目数。取值范围：1~100，默认值为20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the prefix list to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的前缀列表所在地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:
If NextToken is empty, no next query exists.
If NextToken has a return value, the value is the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
如果NextToken为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果NextToken有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

PrefixListAssociation.description_en: The association information of the prefix list
PrefixListAssociation.description_zh: 前缀列表的关联关系列表信息

items.description_en: The association information of the prefix list
items.description_zh: 前缀列表的关联关系列表信息

CidrList.description_en: The list of CIDR blocks in the prefix list that are effective for the associated resource
CidrList.description_zh: 前缀列表在当前关联资源中生效的CIDR地址列表

OwnerId.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the prefix list
OwnerId.description_zh: 前缀列表所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

PrefixListId.description_en: The instance ID of the prefix list

Reason.description_en: The reason for the association failure

RegionId.description_en: The region ID of the prefix list
RegionId.description_zh: 要查询的前缀列表所在地域ID

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the associated resource

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the associated resource. Valid values:

vpcRouteTable: VPC route table.
trRouteTable: transit router route table
ResourceType.description_zh:
关联的资源类型。取值：

vpcRouteTable：VPC路由表。
trRouteTable：转发路由器的路由表

ResourceUid.description_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account that owns the resource associated with the prefix list
ResourceUid.description_zh: 前缀列表所绑定资源所属的阿里云账号（主账号）ID

Status.description_en:
The association status of the prefix list. Valid values:

Created: Succeeded.
ModifyFailed: Not associated with the latest version.
Creating: Being created.
Modifying: Being modified.
Deleting: Being deleted.
Deleted: Deleted
Status.description_zh:
前缀列表的关联状态。取值：

Created：成功。
ModifyFailed：未关联到最新版本。
Creating：创建中。
Modifying：修改中。
Deleting：删除中。
Deleted：已删除

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
